## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`, investigation Step 3)

Run 6: electron side, n = +3.2×10¹² (B 0→10 T, 10 mT above 1 T). Run 7: hole side, n = −1.2×10¹² (B 10→0.3 T, 20 mT). Both complete, T_sample at base throughout, no rails (sr1 ≤ 0.12 of full scale). Raw first, then onset (`sdh_onset`) and 1/B FFT (`sdh_fft`) with a low-B-cutoff stability sweep; model template lines from `fs_count_b0` (ABAB pair / ABCA singleton / F_L) at each spot density.

# Runs 6 & 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check` step 6): raw, onset, 1/B FFT vs FS-count templates
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft

I_BIAS = 10e-9
R_FS = 50e-6 / I_BIAS   # sr1 50 uV, gain 1 -> 5 kOhm full scale

# Model refs: fs_count_b0 (hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count), computed this session at the spot densities.
MODEL = {6: dict(n=+3.2, F_L=33.09, abab=[(7.31, 0.027), (25.78, 0.061)], abca=(33.08, 0.074)),
         7: dict(n=-1.2, F_L=12.41, abab=[(5.86, 0.074), (6.54, 0.032)], abca=(12.41, 1.122))}
CUTS = {6: (1.0, 1.4, 1.8), 7: (0.71, 0.93, 1.14)}   # FFT low-B cutoffs (stability sweep)
BMIN = {6: 1.0, 7: 0.3}   # run 6 < 1 T is a 50 mT grid: undersamples the 7.1 T tone (aliases) — excluded

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8.5))
for row, fid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    run = open_run(f"data/{fid}")
    assert not run.interrupted, f"run {fid} interrupted"
    i = np.argsort(run.col("magnet_field"))
    B, R = run.col("magnet_field")[i], run.col("sr1_X")[i] / I_BIAS
    T = run.col("T_sample")
    print(f"=== run {fid}: n = {MODEL[fid]['n']:+.1f}e12, D = 0, {len(B)} pts, "
          f"B {B.min():.2f}->{B.max():.2f} T, T_sample {T.min():.3f}-{T.max():.3f} K ===")
    ax = axes[row]
    ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=0.5)
    ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title=f"run {fid} raw — n = {MODEL[fid]['n']:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    m = B >= BMIN[fid]
    dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=R_FS)
    print(on.summary())
    ax[1].plot(B[m], dR, lw=0.5)
    ax[1].axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", lw=1)
    ax[1].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm)",
              title=f"deg-5 poly(B) removed (B >= {BMIN[fid]} T); onset marker {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    for cut in CUTS[fid]:
        fr, sp = sdh_fft(R[m][:, None], B[m], b_range=(cut, 10.0), bg_degree=5, log=False)
        s = sp[0] / sp[0][fr > 3].max()
        ax[2].plot(fr, s, lw=0.8, label=f"cut {cut:.2f} T")
        if cut == CUTS[fid][1]:
            f3, s3 = fr[fr > 3], sp[0][fr > 3]
            pk, pr = find_peaks(s3, height=0.1 * s3.max(), distance=3)
            top = pk[np.argsort(pr["peak_heights"])[::-1][:6]]
            print(f"FFT peaks (cut {cut:.2f} T, F > 3 T): " + ", ".join(f"{f3[k]:.1f}" for k in top) + " T")
    md = MODEL[fid]
    for F, _ in md["abab"]:
        ax[2].axvline(F, color="k", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[2].axvline(md["F_L"], color="g", ls="--", lw=1)
    ax[2].set(xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="amp (norm to max > 3 T)", xlim=(0, 45), ylim=(0, 1.6),
              title=f"1/B FFT — dotted: ABAB {md['abab'][0][0]:.1f}/{md['abab'][1][0]:.1f} T; green: F_L {md['F_L']:.1f} T")
    ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

**Take (Step 3, hedged — the fan decides):**

- **Electron side (run 6) — the cleaner side, and the fan side.** Dominant tone **7.1 T** (SNR 40–90 across its family) = the ABAB light pocket (model 7.31 T) at global density scale ≈ 0.97, well inside the lever-arm prior. The higher content {14.1, 22.1, 29.5 T} is degenerate at this record's δF (1.6–2.4 T) between harmonics of 7.1 (14.2 / 21.3 / 28.4) and the ABAB heavy tone (model 25.8 → 25.0 at scale 0.97); the fan's per-column F(n) trajectories + Luttinger partition resolve this (a harmonic tracks k·f exactly; a real pocket follows its own Onsager curve). An ABCA singleton (33.1 T, m* 0.074) would put the dominant weight at ≈ F_L with no strong 7 T fundamental — disfavored, but the F_L-region tone still owes the origin test (investigation Verify).
- **Onset caveat, e-side:** the "censored at 0.30 T" flags (tones 3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 + the 7.1 carrier) ride the 50 mT sub-1 T segment, which undersamples a 7.1 T tone below ~1 T — alias-suspect, treated as *unmeasured* below 1 T. Per `landau-fan` step 1 lever (1), a censored carrying tone means the record never captured the onset: a cheap 5 mT low-field extension (0 → 1 T) pins B_lo before the fan and doubles as the grid-change reproduction for the sub-1 T tones.
- **Hole side (run 7):** onset **0.71 T**; broad paired lobes at ≈ 4.1–4.7 and 6.6–7.2 T plus a strong sharp tone at **12.3 T ≈ F_L (12.41)**. This is the documented near-CNP exception regime (model ABAB pair 5.86/6.54 T — close and balanced, beat-like). An ABCA hole-side singleton carries m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ → LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K, so the strong F_L tone reads naturally as the symmetry-allowed inter-block breakdown/sum orbit over a two-pocket set, not an ABCA pocket. Consistent-with two Fermi surfaces; not decisive at |n| = 1.2×10¹².
- **Both sides lean two-FS (ABAB-like), no template rejected yet.** Hand-off to Step 4: electron side, n up to +3.2×10¹², Δ(1/B) ≤ 1/(3·F_L(n_max)), sr1 50 µV held, dwell at the settling floor; B_lo from the extension run.

## HERA — Step 3c: low-field extension of the e-side spot check (`sdh-spot-check`), pins the fan's B_lo

> **05:29** · sdh-spot-check e-side low-field ext: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->1.05 T 5 mT (211 pts), delay 0, sr1 50 uV; pins fan B\_lo; ends 1.05 T · **ETA ~05:54** (≈25 min)

Run 6's onset came back **censored at the record edge**: the carrying 7.1 T tone is above threshold through the lowest window, but the sub-1 T segment was sampled at 50 mT — under Nyquist for a 7.1 T tone below ~1 T, so the low-B tone claims are alias-suspect and the true onset is unmeasured. `landau-fan` step 1, lever (1): a censored carrying tone gets a **cheap low-field extension before the fan commits** — B_lo is the fan's most expensive lever (uniform-1/B rows pile up at low B: every 0.1 T of unnecessary B_lo margin costs ~30–70 rows ≈ 1.5–4 h of fan time). Same spot as run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0, run-5 cal), B 0 → 1.05 T at **5 mT** (211 pts): Nyquist for the 7.1 T tone down to ~0.27 T, and a grid-change reproduction (recipe Verify) that retires or confirms the alias-suspect 3–5 T tones. Magnet sits at 0 T (handoff) — the sweep starts where it is and ends at 1.05 T, from which the fan positions. sr1 held at 50 µV. Checkpoint: first ~20 rows via the armed watch (signal, leakage, field tracking); read lands with the fan design.

# === sdh-spot-check, e-side LOW-FIELD EXTENSION: n = +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0 -> 1.05 T at 5 mT (pins the fan's B_lo) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) — same spot as run 6 ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: 5 mT uniform, 0 -> 1.05 T. Nyquist for the 7.1 T tone holds down to B ~ 0.27 T
#     (dB/B^2 <= 1/(2*7.1)); overlaps run 6's 10 mT segment above 1 T for grid-change reproduction.
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.0, 1.0501, 0.005), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # same scale as run 6 (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm; no MR headroom concern below 1 T)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 5 mT; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check e-side low-field extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm "
                  f"(run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 1.05 T, 5 mT, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'e-side LOW-FIELD EXTENSION of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0 -> 1.05 T uniform-B 5 mT; '
              f'pins the landau-fan B_lo (run 6 sub-1 T segment was 50 mT = alias-suspect) + grid-change reproduction')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.05 T — the fan positions from there (down to its B_lo).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
